model.rationale: TX-37's D+30 lean and Casar's roughly nine-to-one fundraising edge over Lauren Peña make a Democratic hold overwhelming; markets price the race near 98% Democratic. With no polls or ratings to contradict the fundamentals, the forecast stays at the baseline margin.
model.watch: A polling surprise or major outside spending against Casar would be the first sign of trouble, but none is currently visible.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Representative Greg Casar seeks another term in a Austin-area district that leans Democratic by about thirty points. He has raised over $1.1 million and holds nearly $600,000 on hand, while Republican Lauren Peña has raised about $130,000 with minimal cash remaining and no outside spending on either side.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings are available, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and money. Prediction markets give Casar roughly a 98% chance of winning. The race is rated Safe Democratic, with the main uncertainty being turnout in a low-information contest.
